prompts.source/reaper-bow-keyposes.png: Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation KEY POSE SPRITE SHEET for the existing Grim Runner game. Reference image is the EXACT accepted character identity and painting style: compact right-facing ivory skull, ONE cyan eye, charcoal hood/coat, burgundy lining/ragged cloak, bronze shoulder armor/belt/boots, ornate bone-bronze scythe on back. Preserve this identity, proportions, colors, silhouette, style. Draw ONE 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet, eight isolated full-body poses, reading left to right then next row. Canvas landscape 1536x1024; each cell 384x512; transparent background, no labels, no text, no borders, NO chest, NO bow. Identical drawing scale in all eight cells, fixed planted foot baseline within each cell near y=480; centered hips x~185. Leave enough margin above raised hands. Character faces right throughout. Poses are a PHYSICAL chest retrieval, arms cannot simply wave upward: 0 relaxed standing hands near waist; 1 knees soften and torso hinges forward 20 degrees at hips, head looks down/right; 2 DEEP bend at knees/hips with torso inclined forward 45 degrees and both arms reaching diagonally DOWN-RIGHT below waist; 3 deepest reach, both gloved skeletal hands close around an imaginary crossbow grip LOW and to the RIGHT at knee level, chin clearly looking down, knees bent; 4 begin standing from hips and knees while both hands carry imaginary object at waist; 5 straightened body both hands carry imaginary object at shoulder height to the right; 6 both arms continue raising above head with elbows still a little bent; 7 triumphant stable upright pose, both arms fully raised OVERHEAD holding an imaginary crossbow, hands close together slightly to right of hood. Hands should be closed grips, clear and readable. Feet stay planted in same stance, same head/torso/boot proportions throughout. Scythe remains securely strapped on back and follows torso. Keep bold clean cartoon painted shapes like reference, restrained texture, no photographic detail, no extra weapons or characters. Ensure each pose has complete feet, scythe, cloak and hands within its OWN cell; no overlap.
